text_en: Editorial Explanation This volume contains a compilation of sixteen sutras and treatises. The nature of these sixteen Buddhist texts is not uniform. Broadly speaking, they can be divided into the following categories:

text_zh: 本冊所收，為十六部經論的滙合。這十六部佛典的性質並不一致。大體可分為下列幾類：
text_en: 1. Chinese translations of Southern (Theravāda) scriptures: from the Southern “Turning the Wheel of Dharma” Sutta to the “Mindfulness of Breathing” Sutta, plus the “Abhidhamma Summary Treatise” at the end of the volume—these eleven works are all Southern Buddhist texts.

text_zh: 一、中譯南傳經典：從南傳轉法輪經，到念安般經，加上卷末的阿毘達磨攝義論，這十一部書都是南傳 佛典。其中，只有巴宙所譯的大般湼槃經與湯用彤所譯的念安般經稍為長一些，其餘諸經的篇幅都 很小。而且，它們或出自小部（如：吉祥經）、或出自長部（如：大般湼槃經）、或出自中部（如： 念安般經），所屬的經典部類並不全同。輯錄這些經典於此，原因固然是由於它們皆為北傳藏經 所未收。但是其中也有本身即頗具重要性的，像大般湼槃經、法句經、念安般經即都是研究原始佛 教的重要資料。此外，卷末的阿毘達磨攝義論是綜括南傳佛教思想的入門要籍，也不可忽略。
text_en: Among them, only the Mahāparinirvāṇa Sūtra translated by Ba Zhou and the Mindfulness of Breathing Sutta translated by Tang Yongtong are somewhat longer; the remaining texts are all very short. Moreover, they come from different collections—some from the Khuddaka Nikāya (e.g., the Mangala Sutta), some from the Dīgha Nikāya (e.g., the Mahāparinirvāṇa Sūtra), and some from the Majjhima Nikāya (e.g., the Mindfulness of Breathing Sutta)—so their canonical classifications are not all the same. These scriptures are compiled here primarily because they are not included in the Northern Transmission canon. However, some of them are also quite important in their own right—for example, the Mahāparinirvāṇa Sūtra, the Dhammapada, and the Mindfulness of Breathing Sutta are all key sources for the study of Early Buddhism. In addition, the Abhidhamma Summary Treatise at the end of the volume is an introductory essential text that summarizes Southern Buddhist thought and should not be overlooked.

2. Chinese translations of Tibetan Buddhist texts: this refers to the Sutra on Recollection of the Three Jewels translated by Master Fazun, and the Bhagavatī Mother “Wisdom Gone to the Other Shore” Heart Sūtra translated by Master Gonga.

text_zh: 二、中譯藏文佛典：這是指法尊法師所譯的隨念三寶經、與貢噶上師所譯的薄伽梵母智慧到彼岸心經。 這二書都附有註釋。隨念三寶經是初學佛者的入門書；薄伽梵母智慧到彼岸心經則是般若心經的新 譯，此一西藏傳本，頗可與心經之其他十餘種不同譯本對勘，對瞭解般若系經典的義理，應有裨益。
text_en: Both works include commentaries. The Sutra on Recollection of the Three Jewels is an introductory book for beginners in Buddhism; the Bhagavatī Mother “Wisdom Gone to the Other Shore” Heart Sūtra is a new translation of the Heart Sūtra. This Tibetan transmission version can be collated against more than ten other different translations of the Heart Sūtra, and should help in understanding the doctrinal meaning of the Prajñā (Prajñāpāramitā) scriptures.
3. Japanese Buddhist texts: this refers to Buddhist works written in Chinese by ancient Japanese scholars; here only the “Poisonous-Words Heart Sūtra” is included.

text_zh: 三、日本佛典：這是指古代日本學者用中文所撰的佛典，此處僅收毒語心經一書。該書又名毒語注心經， 原為十八世紀時日本禪宗名僧白隱慧鶴為心經所作的禪宗式註釋。後來又有南天棒鄧州（即「中 原鄧州」）的提唱（「提唱」謂提示宗旨、大要）。此處所收，即南天棒鄧州的提唱本。
text_en: This book is also called “Poisonous-Words Annotated Heart Sūtra,” originally a Zen-style commentary on the Heart Sūtra written in the 18th century by the famous Japanese Zen monk Hakuin Ekaku. Later, Nantianbang Dengzhou (i.e., “Zhongyuan Dengzhou”) added “teaching talks” (“teaching talks” meaning guidance pointing out the central aim and main points). This volume contains the teaching-talk version by Nantianbang Dengzhou.
4. Buddhist commentaries by eminent modern Chinese masters: two works are included—“Lectures/Exposition on the Diamond Sūtra” and “Essential Collected Notes on the Amitābha Sūtra.”

text_zh: 四、我國近代大德的佛經注疏：計收金剛經講義及阿彌陀經注釋會要二書。前者為民國以來註釋金剛經 的名著，後者對阿彌陀經的內容有詳細的解說，也值得注意。
text_en: The former is a renowned commentary on the Diamond Sūtra since the Republican era; the latter provides a detailed explanation of the content of the Amitābha Sūtra and is also worth noting.
